statements.subject: context
statements.description: Agents MAY generate a new contextId when processing a Message that does not include a contextId field
actions: Generate a new contextId

statements.subject: context
statements.description: If an agent generates a new contextId, it MUST be included in the response (either Task or Message)
actions: Include generated contextId in response (Task or Message)

statements.subject: context
statements.description: Agents MAY accept and preserve client-provided contextId values
actions: Accept client-provided contextId
Preserve client-provided contextId value

statements.subject: context
statements.description: If an agent cannot accept a client-provided contextId, it MUST reject the request with an error and MUST NOT generate a new contextId for the response
actions: Reject the request with an error

statements.subject: context
statements.description: If an agent cannot accept a client-provided contextId, it MUST reject the request with an error and MUST NOT generate a new contextId for the response
actions: Do not generate a new contextId for the response

statements.subject: context
statements.description: Clients SHOULD NOT provide a client-generated contextId to a server unless they understand how the server will process that contextId
actions: Do not provide a client-generated contextId to a server when server contextId processing behavior is not understood

statements.subject: context
statements.description: Server-generated contextId values SHOULD be treated as opaque identifiers by clients
actions: Treat server-generated contextId values as opaque identifiers

statements.subject: context
statements.description: All tasks and messages with the same contextId SHOULD be treated as part of the same conversational session
actions: Treat all tasks and messages with the same contextId as part of the same conversational session

statements.subject: context
statements.description: Agents MAY use the contextId to maintain internal state, conversational history, or LLM context across multiple interactions
actions: Use contextId to maintain internal state
Use contextId to maintain conversational history
Use contextId to maintain LLM context across multiple interactions

statements.subject: context
statements.description: Agents MAY implement context expiration or cleanup policies and SHOULD document any such policies
actions: Implement context expiration or cleanup policies

statements.subject: context
statements.description: Agents MAY implement context expiration or cleanup policies and SHOULD document any such policies
actions: Document context expiration or cleanup policies

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Agents MUST generate a unique taskId for each new task they create
actions: Generate a unique taskId for each new task created

statements.subject: task
statements.description: The generated taskId MUST be included in the Task object returned to the client
actions: Include generated taskId in the Task object returned to the client

statements.subject: task
statements.description: When a client includes a taskId in a Message, it MUST reference an existing task
actions: Reference an existing task when including taskId in a Message

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Agents MUST return a TaskNotFoundError if the provided taskId does not correspond to an existing task
actions: Return a TaskNotFoundError to the client

statements.subject: context
statements.description: Clients MAY include the contextId in subsequent messages to indicate continuation of a previous interaction
actions: Include contextId in subsequent messages to indicate continuation of a previous interaction

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Clients MAY use taskId (with or without contextId) to continue or refine a specific task
actions: Use taskId to continue or refine a specific task

statements.subject: context
statements.description: Clients MAY use contextId without taskId to start a new task within an existing conversation context
actions: Use contextId without taskId to start a new task within an existing conversation context

statements.subject: context
statements.description: Agents MUST infer contextId from the task if only taskId is provided
actions: Infer contextId from the referenced task when only taskId is provided in the message

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Agents MUST reject messages containing mismatching contextId and taskId (i.e., the provided contextId is different from that of the referenced Task).
statements.pre_cond: message.contextId != null & message.taskId != null & message.contextId != task.contextId
actions: Reject the message containing mismatching contextId and taskId

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Clients SHOULD use the referenceTaskIds field in Message to explicitly reference related tasks
actions: Populate the referenceTaskIds field in Message to explicitly reference related tasks

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Agents SHOULD use referenced tasks to understand the context and intent of follow-up requests
actions: Use referenced tasks to understand the context and intent of follow-up requests

statements.subject: context
statements.description: Agents SHOULD leverage the shared contextId to provide contextually relevant responses
actions: Leverage shared contextId to provide contextually relevant responses
